description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Injector_SafeObject, which extends HTMLPurifier_Injector to add security features for object and param HTML elements, ensuring safe embedding of objects by adding and validating parameters.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Injector_SafeObject
classes.description: A class that extends HTMLPurifier_Injector to add security parameters to object tags and handle related tokens.

methods.description: Prepares the injector with configuration and context, calling parent prepare method.

methods.description: Handles the end of 'object' tokens to manage internal stacks.
